_comment: Table-pair allowlist for duplicate-table-audit.mjs, keyed 'tableA|tableB' with tableA < tableB alphabetically. Every entry cites the ADR/migration-comment/ruling that already disambiguated the pair. A pair not listed here that this checker flags is a NEW finding, not a silent pass. Empty by design (coordinator ruling, 2026-09-25): the 8 DUP-1-confirmed pairs (docs/audits/supabase-integrity-and-wiring-audit-2026-09-25.md finding DUP-1) were previously seeded here, but an allowlist is for ACCEPTED NON-ISSUES, not KNOWN POSITIVES this checker's job is to keep catching. Those 8 pairs are now locked into the calibration fixture instead (scripts/verify/lib/duplicate-table-scan.test.mjs's POSITIVES, backed by fixtures/duplicate-table-schema-snapshot.json) and are EXPECTED to keep appearing in every live run's candidate output, same as any other flagged pair, each disposed by the reader of that run's output, not suppressed here.
